findings: Currency, earned/unissued balances, conversion, fixed-event rules and budget description match assigned materials.
Q3 distribution is not redemption or actual annual cash. Repeating four quarters is a declared scenario.
Unknown fund formula, Thanks event links, tenure stacking and certificate window remain unknown. No unsupported timeliness or universal funding guarantee was added.
Status covers factual description, not measured program effectiveness or financial feasibility.
Incumbent concept is byte-identical to sealed source; SHA256 verified d788233adbc45aa9b9b4af55fc64c3af074c3f505450ef92b2940337f78f3487.
Social-recognition and fairness hypotheses, J rights and capacities are expressly own assumptions; no measured OTP effect is claimed.
Stopping future fixed/R accrual is part of this unchanged concept. It conflicts with updated direction but is a substantive scope issue, not source fabrication.
Old M01/M02 calculations do not establish current M04 finance pass; fresh check required.
E03–E05 were checked only through assigned frozen summaries of abstracts, not full studies; they justify questions, not J policy or an OTP effect coefficient.
Fixed grounds/rates and earned rights are preserved in stated policy; 8m R is a hypothetical whole future fund, not verified bank allocation.
89.705% is arithmetic reduction versus 19,427,591 R×4=77,710,364 annual extrapolation, not actual annual saving; concept discloses this price/risk.
LOW96 is an alternative event-frequency assumption with unchanged rules/rates, not a policy cut or measured emission.
R01–R07 support existence of borrowed procedures only. New 5000/10000 R levels, five-day target, workload and catalog are project assumptions.
1600 minimum rewards/year and 22.22% max unique coverage are scenario upper bounds, not predicted reach.
All-rights stress failures, absent real backing and unmeasured acceptance are disclosed. Evidence status partial reflects unverified transfer/implementation inputs, not an unsupported hypothesis.
Pilot caveats distinguish process effect at equal fund from acceptance of fund reduction and pure nonmaterial causal channel.

Guarantee applies to pre-admitted people meeting their pre-agreed personal conditions; admission is limited before effort. It is not a promise to all employees and is not conditional on winning the contest or residual funds after admission.

The base guarantee plus contest is explicitly an OTP design hypothesis. GitLab finite awards and Berkeley discretionary awards do not establish a universal guaranteed reward; the concept states that transfer limit correctly.

300 admissions/quarter, 1200/year, 5000 R base, ten groups and own tie/combination/team-pool rules are prospective design assumptions, not published OTP or external facts. Six-year rotation is labelled an arithmetic lower bound, not an individual promise.

Fixed reasons/rates and old rights are retained in stated policy. 8m R is the whole hypothetical future fund, 89.7% compares to Q3-times-four scenario, and LOW96 differs by event frequency rather than a policy cut. None is represented as actual annual bank data.

The concept separates allocation measures from program outcomes, receipt from an order, conditional/earned obligations from unissued free funds, and narrow procurement from labor. Actual catalogue, supplier calendar, prices, hours and full-rights backing remain unverified; failures are disclosed.

Pilot compares the entire admitted-guarantee/contest process with discretionary allocation at equal prospective fund; it cannot isolate a guarantee effect or prove bank-wide CSI/ER. Five matched pairs may be too imprecise and are labelled an operability test if so.

Noncritical wording nuance: the claim that there is no incentive to hide errors or withhold knowledge should be read as a design intention. The same section expressly says cooperation safeguards are not proven prevention and lists withholding/rivalry risks; no measured prevention effect is established.

financial_gates: assigned to independent finance check; not determined here
scope_note: All four assigned descriptions checked. Supported describes the baseline factual account; partial for designs reflects limited transfer/actual inputs, not source fabrication or a requirement to prove every hypothesis.
significant_unresolved: Real gross fixed-event issuance, personal C/R and unposted rights/orders/backing are not provided.
Actual catalogue denominations and regional suitability, lead times, permitted commitment/reserve operations and named labor capacity require prelaunch validation.
No measured OTP effect or acceptance of the smaller whole future fund has been established.
Independent finance check determines budget/currency feasibility and cannot be overridden by this evidence status.
Incumbent noncompliance with preserving future fixed accrual is substantive scope assessment, not evidence dishonesty.
